title: Q2 contracts & billing journal - Rajiv
content:
Q2 Contracts + Billing Journal - running personal scratchpad
Owner: Rajiv Singh (fin-legal)
Quick context: Mixed day-to-day checks — invoices to clear, a couple of small contract redlines to prep for Legal review, renewal nudges to product managers. Use this as my morning checklist and an informal audit trail.

TODAY (2026-03-12)
- [ ] Invoice review: Vendor: BrightData Labs — INV-2026-017 (due 2026-03-18) amt $7,420. Expected PO: PO-5021. Quick check: PO matches line items? finance sheet shows PO-5021 for $7,400 (discrepancy $20). Ask AP: Lucy to confirm credit memos. Slack @lucy-wong.
- [ ] Chase: OTTMetrics billing dispute — INV-889 (sat on legal hold) contact: Priya (solutions) — need statement of work attachment. Action: attach SOW v2 and mark as disputed in NetSuite (JIRA:FIN-342)
- [x] Renewal reminder sent: Snyk-like monitoring tool (vendor: ShieldOps) renewal 2026-04-01. Sent PM (Ava) draft renewal blurb 2026-03-11.

CONTRACT REDLINES (to prep before Legal review)
- ShieldOps SOW v2: remove unlimited liability clause, propose cap = 1x annual fees. Suggest language: "Liability cap limited to direct damages not to exceed fees paid in previous 12 months."
- Data retention addendum for BrightData: require deletion confirmation within 30 days post-termination. Add small checkbox for on-prem export approval.
- Quick note: for smaller vendors (<$50k ARR) propose using standard limited-terms template to speed sign-offs. Tag: LEGAL-128.

OPEN ITEMS / BLOCKERS
- Discrepancies: PO vs invoice amounts (BrightData $20). Low priority but need to close before payment run 2026-03-18.
- Missing SOW for INV-889 (OTTMetrics) — blocks dispute close. Ask SE Priya to upload to Confluence under contracts/OTTmetrics.
- Vendor bank change request: Received email from VendorPayments@cloudinsight asking for bank update. Raise internal verification — avoid wire until legal confirms.

FOLLOW-UPS (this week)
1) Lucy: confirm credit memo or updated invoice from BrightData by EOD 2026-03-13.
2) Maya: can you take initial redlines on ShieldOps and ping Legal? I drafted suggested cap above; want Legal to confirm acceptable wording.
3) PMs: get renewal decision on ShieldOps by 2026-03-20 (auto-renew date 2026-04-01). If not, set reminder to start migration plan.
4) AP: include disputed INV-889 in next exception report; schedule quick sync 2026-03-15.

NOTES TO SELF
- Keep a running list of small vendors where we accept limited T&Cs (speed wins) — create a quick label in Confluence for "fast-approve" vendors.
- When redlining, always capture the clause number and send a one-line rationale for Legal (helps speed reviews).
- If a invoiced amount < $100 variance, consider auto-approve with note and move forward if vendor confirms in thread.

REFERENCES / LINKS
- Confluence: contracts/renewal-template (use for ShieldOps)
- Jira: FIN-342 (OTTMetrics invoice dispute), LEGAL-128 (ShieldOps review)
- Slack: #billing (thread ts:1647382938) — contains BrightData invoice snapshot

Quick log of small past actions (for trace)
- 2026-03-11: Sent ShieldOps renewal ping to PM (Ava) + Legal heads-up (Maya).
- 2026-03-09: Flagged INV-889 to Legal, requested SOW from Priya.
- 2026-03-05: Cleared vendor monthly reconciliation for March (sampled 45 invoices).

End of scratchpad entry — will prune/transfer items to formal trackers (Jira / Confluence) after lunchtime triage.
